metadata.remarks:
Server Monitoring and Response defines the capability to observe server and workload behavior, detect indicators of compromise or misuse, and coordinate effective response actions. This pattern provides oversight and enterprise-scale awareness and is intentionally distinct from local runtime protections. It enables incident handling, forensics, and recovery decisions across the server fleet.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to server observability, detection, and response coordination. Controls are intentionally scoped to visibility and response enablement and exclude runtime enforcement and configuration management.

components.title: Telemetry Collection

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collect server audit records and security telemetry in a centralized manner.

components.title: Detection and Correlation
components.description: Analysis and correlation of server telemetry to detect malicious or abnormal activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Analyze server activity to identify indicators of compromise or misuse.
Review and analyze server audit logs for security-relevant events.

components.title: Incident Response Coordination
components.description: Coordination of response activities across operational, security, and recovery teams.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Coordinate server incident response activities with defined procedures.

components.title: Evidence and Forensics
